name: Living Fortress [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Stubborn, tenacious, and proud, you’re all but immovable when you have kin to back you up.

Prerequisite(s): Dwarf, hardy ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you fight defensively and you’re adjacent to an ally, your allies’ ancestral bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities increases by 2. If they do not have them, they are treated as having an initial ancestral bonus of +0.

Polymorph: Spiritual Ally, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: G. Tyler Ernst.
